Create a custom bandit environment

Source: R/environments.R
bandit_custom.Rd

Wraps a user-supplied reward sampler so that any stochastic reward process can run in run_experiment() without modifying the package.

Usage

bandit_custom(sampler, arms, expected_rewards = NULL)

Arguments

sampler

A function of one argument, the arm name, returning a single finite numeric reward.

arms

Character vector of at least two unique arm names.

expected_rewards

Optional named numeric vector of true expected rewards, one per arm. When supplied, regret metrics are computed; when NULL (the default), regret columns are NA because the oracle value is unknown.

Value

A bandit_environment object.

Details

The sampler is called once per decision with the selected arm name and the current R random number generator state; use the current RNG (e.g. stats::rexp()) rather than setting seeds inside the sampler, otherwise reproducibility guarantees of run_experiment() are lost.

See also

run_experiment(), sample_reward()

Examples

env <- bandit_custom(
  sampler = function(arm) rexp(1, rate = if (arm == "fast") 2 else 1),
  arms = c("fast", "slow"),
  expected_rewards = c(fast = 0.5, slow = 1)
)
env
#> <custom_environment> 2 arms: fast, slow
#> expected rewards:
#> fast slow 
#>  0.5  1.0 
#> optimal arm(s): slow
